Admissions requirements

Finding the
right fit.

Admission depends on an accepted application and the conditions established by the Board of Directors.

Kindergarten

New kindergarten applicants complete a readiness test. A testing fee may apply.

Grades 1–8

Provide grades and testing records from previous schools. Applicants must complete an admissions test; a testing fee may apply. Where applicable, prior results should meet grade-level expectations, including passing Texas state tests, with above-average grades and good citizenship.

For every applicant

The school considers readiness, preparation, and motivation through testing, recommendations, and/or interviews.

2026–2027 school year

Tuition & fees

View the complete tuition schedule
Standard tuition and multi-child rates
ProgramAnnual tuitionMonthly paymentPrepay in full
Preschool$3,240.00$324.00$3,175.20
Preschool · multi-child$3,078.00$307.80$3,016.44
Kindergarten–Grade 8$6,850.00$685.00$6,713.00
K–8 · multi-child$6,507.50$650.75$6,377.35

Automatic payments are drafted on the 10th or 25th. The multi-child rate applies to children other than the oldest enrolled child. Full prepayment must be received by August 1 to qualify for the listed discount.

Enrollment & grade-level fees

New student enrollment is $200. Returning student enrollment is $200 when registered by May 31; after June 1, the listed fees are $300 for Pre-K and $400 for K–8.

Grade-level fees: $160 for Pre-K and $300 for K–8. Enrollment fees secure your child’s place; grade-level fees are due by August 1.

Extended enrichment

Monthly rates are $235 for Pre-K five days a week, $130 for Pre-K until 3 p.m. five days a week, and $130 for K–8 five days a week. Daily drop-in rates are $30 for Pre-K and $20 for K–8.

Contact the school to confirm availability and the arrangement that fits your family.

Financial aid & scholarships

Trinity’s aid and scholarship program is funded by private donations and foundation grants. Contact the school for details about availability and applying.

Texas Education Freedom Accounts

The school’s website states that Trinity accepts TEFA funds. Find the school’s application resources and contact the office with questions about using these funds.

TEFA information and application resources

A welcoming school community

Trinity’s admissions policy welcomes students regardless of race, creed, color, sex, national origin, or ethnic origin. For the school’s complete nondiscrimination statement and policies, please read the official admissions information.
